description: Browse the flash-unstake market: `available` (open orders buyers can take), `ongoing` (being paid out) or `completed`. Amounts are SUN-scaled numbers; `estimateCompletionTime` is seconds. Use to browse the whole market; the user's own request is `tronsave_get_flash_unstake_request` and a payout preview is `tronsave_estimate_flash_unstake`. Public, read-only.

kind.description: Which orders to list: available (default), ongoing or completed.

offset.description: Number of orders to skip for pagination (default 0); add `limit` to page forward.

name: tronsave_list_flash_unstake_orders
title: Flash Unstake Market
